neighborhoods.name: Pagrati
neighborhoods.description: Lively, walkable neighborhood next to the Panathenaic Stadium, full of cafés, tavernas and bars around Plateia Varnava and Plastira.

pros.text: Huge choice of cafés, bars and cheap food
Everything you need within a few blocks
Popular with students and young people

cons.text: No metro station: you rely on buses or a 15-minute walk to Evangelismos/Syntagma
Rents have risen a lot in recent years

neighborhoods.name: Kypseli
neighborhoods.description: Dense, diverse central neighborhood with the pedestrian Fokionos Negri street and the Pedion tou Areos park nearby.

pros.text: Pedion tou Areos park and Fokionos Negri for walks

cons.text: No metro: buses/trolleys or a walk to Victoria/Ampelokipoi
Very dense, some streets feel run-down
Older buildings, check heating and insulation

neighborhoods.name: Exarchia
neighborhoods.description: The historic student and alternative quarter, packed with bookshops, bars and cheap eats, walking distance from the center.

pros.text: The most student-heavy area in Athens
Endless bars, live music and cheap food
Walk to Omonia, Panepistimio and the center

cons.text: Noisy, especially at night and on weekends
Short-term rentals have pushed rents up

neighborhoods.name: Neapoli
neighborhoods.description: Quieter neighbor of Exarchia at the foot of Lycabettus, with the same student vibe but calmer streets.

pros.text: Close to Exarchia's nightlife without living in it

cons.text: No metro station inside the area

neighborhoods.name: Koukaki
neighborhoods.description: Charming area below the Acropolis and Filopappou hill, with pedestrian streets and lots of cafés.

pros.text: Filopappou hill for walks and views

cons.text: One of the most Airbnb-heavy areas: expensive and hard to find long-term rentals

neighborhoods.name: Ampelokipoi
neighborhoods.description: Busy, central residential area around Alexandras and Kifisias avenues with excellent transport.

pros.text: Close to NKUA Goudi and NTUA/NKUA Zografou campuses
Every shop and service you need

cons.text: Heavy traffic and noise on the main avenues

neighborhoods.name: Gyzi
neighborhoods.description: Residential neighborhood between Kypseli and Ampelokipoi, quieter than both and reasonably priced.

pros.text: Good value for a central area

neighborhoods.name: Patisia
neighborhoods.description: Large, dense area along Patision street, one of the cheapest options with direct metro to the center.

pros.text: Among the cheapest rents in central Athens
Close to AUEB and NTUA Patision

cons.text: Perceived as less safe, especially at night

neighborhoods.name: Petralona
neighborhoods.description: Neighborhood-feel area beside Filopappou hill, known for its tavernas and relaxed atmosphere.

cons.text: Rents rising due to short-term rentals
Some streets near the rail line are noisy

neighborhoods.name: Neos Kosmos
neighborhoods.description: Practical residential area south of the center with metro and tram access.

neighborhoods.name: Mets
neighborhoods.description: Small, quiet, picturesque area near the Panathenaic Stadium and the National Garden.

pros.text: Near the National Garden and Ardittos hill

neighborhoods.name: Ilisia
neighborhoods.description: Upmarket central area around Evangelismos and the Megaro Mousikis, a short ride from the Zografou campuses.

neighborhoods.name: Kolonaki
neighborhoods.description: The most upscale central neighborhood, below Lycabettus, full of boutiques and cafés.

pros.text: Walk to the center and NKUA's central buildings

cons.text: The most expensive area on the list

neighborhoods.name: Metaxourgeio
neighborhoods.description: Gentrifying area west of Omonia, close to Gazi's nightlife, with art spaces and new cafés.

pros.text: Affordable for how central it is

cons.text: Some blocks feel unsafe at night

neighborhoods.name: Kolonos
neighborhoods.description: Working-class residential area northwest of the center, cheap and quiet.

pros.text: Close to KTEL Kifisou/Liosion and Larissis station

neighborhoods.name: Sepolia
neighborhoods.description: Quiet residential area on metro line 2, handy for getting out of Athens.

pros.text: Very close to KTEL Liosion and Larissis station

neighborhoods.name: Zografou
neighborhoods.description: The classic student district, right next to the NKUA and NTUA Zografou campuses, at the foot of Mount Hymettus.

pros.text: Walk or a short bus ride to the NKUA/NTUA campuses
Thousands of students: easy to make friends
Lots of cheap food and student cafés

cons.text: High demand for flats before the academic year

neighborhoods.name: Goudi
neighborhoods.description: Calm area by Goudi park and the NKUA medical school, between Ampelokipoi and Zografou.

pros.text: Next to NKUA Goudi (Medicine, Dentistry, Nursing)
Goudi park for running and walks

cons.text: Few shops and bars in the area itself

neighborhoods.name: Kaisariani
neighborhoods.description: Historic, friendly neighborhood bordering Pagrati and Zografou, at the edge of Hymettus forest.

pros.text: Hymettus and Kaisariani forest for hiking

neighborhoods.name: Vyronas
neighborhoods.description: Quiet, green residential municipality below Hymettus, popular with families and students.

cons.text: No metro: buses to the center

neighborhoods.name: Ymittos
neighborhoods.description: Small, calm residential area between Pagrati and Dafni.

pros.text: Walk to Pagrati for going out

neighborhoods.name: Cholargos
neighborhoods.description: Leafy, safe northern-eastern suburb on metro line 3.

neighborhoods.name: Papagou
neighborhoods.description: Very quiet, green, upmarket residential suburb near Ethniki Amyna.

cons.text: Almost no nightlife or student life

neighborhoods.name: Agia Paraskevi
neighborhoods.description: Self-contained suburb with its own center, shops and nightlife, on metro line 3.

pros.text: Metro line 3 and direct line to the airport

cons.text: Far from the western and southern campuses
Pricier than central areas of similar size

neighborhoods.name: Chalandri
neighborhoods.description: Popular northern suburb with a lively main square full of bars and restaurants.

pros.text: One of the best suburban nightlife spots
Safe, with parks and the Pikrodafni stream

cons.text: Long commute to central and western campuses

neighborhoods.name: Galatsi
neighborhoods.description: Residential area next to the Tourkovounia hills and Veikou park.

neighborhoods.name: Nea Ionia
neighborhoods.description: Quiet northern municipality with good shopping on metro line 1.

neighborhoods.name: Nea Filadelfeia
neighborhoods.description: Calm area with the large Alsos Neas Filadelfeias park.

neighborhoods.name: Marousi
neighborhoods.description: Business hub of the north with malls, offices and metro line 1 plus the suburban railway.

cons.text: Far from the center and most campuses

neighborhoods.name: Kifisia
neighborhoods.description: Affluent, green northern suburb at the end of metro line 1.

pros.text: Beautiful area with lots of shops

cons.text: Long commute to almost every campus

neighborhoods.name: Ano Patisia
neighborhoods.description: Residential area at the top of Patision street, cheaper than the center with metro line 1.

neighborhoods.name: Nea Smyrni
neighborhoods.description: Pleasant, safe area with a big central square, a large park and the tram.

pros.text: Tram to the center and the beach

neighborhoods.name: Kallithea
neighborhoods.description: Large, dense area that is home to Panteion and Harokopio universities.

neighborhoods.name: Palaio Faliro
neighborhoods.description: Seaside suburb with a marina, beaches and the tram along the coast.

cons.text: No metro; far from northern campuses

neighborhoods.name: Dafni
neighborhoods.description: Residential area on metro line 2, a quick ride to Syntagma.

pros.text: NKUA Physical Education campus is here

neighborhoods.name: Agios Dimitrios
neighborhoods.description: Practical southern suburb on metro line 2.

neighborhoods.name: Alimos
neighborhoods.description: Seaside suburb with a marina, on metro line 2.

neighborhoods.name: Glyfada
neighborhoods.description: Upmarket coastal suburb with beaches, shopping and nightlife.

cons.text: Far from almost every campus (tram/bus only)

neighborhoods.name: Moschato
neighborhoods.description: Quiet area on metro line 1 between Kallithea and Piraeus.

neighborhoods.name: Tavros
neighborhoods.description: Affordable area near Panteion, Harokopio and the Athens School of Fine Arts.

neighborhoods.name: Egaleo
neighborhoods.description: Western suburb with its own lively center, home to the University of West Attica campuses.

pros.text: Next to UniWA (Egaleo Park and Ancient Olive Grove)

cons.text: Perceived as less safe in some parts

neighborhoods.name: Peristeri
neighborhoods.description: One of Athens' largest municipalities, with a busy commercial center and metro line 2.

cons.text: Long trip to the eastern campuses

neighborhoods.name: Ilion
neighborhoods.description: Quiet residential suburb in the northwest.

neighborhoods.name: Petroupoli
neighborhoods.description: Green, quiet suburb with the large Petroupoli park and open-air theater.

neighborhoods.name: Piraeus
neighborhoods.description: Port city with its own center, the University of Piraeus and lively waterfronts at Pasalimani and Mikrolimano.

pros.text: Next to the University of Piraeus
Metro lines 1 and 3, tram, suburban rail and the port

cons.text: Some areas near the port are rough at night

neighborhoods.name: Neo Faliro
neighborhoods.description: Area between Piraeus and Faliro around the Peace & Friendship Stadium.

pros.text: Close to the University of Piraeus

neighborhoods.name: Nikaia
neighborhoods.description: Large, affordable municipality on metro line 3.

neighborhoods.name: Korydallos
neighborhoods.description: Residential area on metro line 3 between Piraeus and Egaleo.

neighborhoods.name: Keratsini
neighborhoods.description: Working-class western suburb of Piraeus, one of the cheapest options.

cons.text: Few students and little to do
